query: How can we reduce incident resolution time?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Categorizing incidents (email, vpn, database) from short_description gives a strong grouping axis to compare resolution times by type. Values match the source text well.

per_column.name: failure_mode
per_column.rationale: Failure mode adds an orthogonal axis (connection vs access vs crash) useful for targeting resolution improvements. Mostly warranted readings, though some ('unresponsive_service' for 'not working properly') are reasonable but slightly inferred.

per_column.name: affected_system_tier
per_column.rationale: System tier (server/network/application/client) is a useful lens for routing and resolution analysis. Largely inferable from category, though a bit correlated with incident_category, and tier assignments are reasonable inferences.

per_column.name: recurrence_signal
per_column.rationale: Recurrence would be valuable for resolution analysis, but it is marked True for 383/500 including one-line descriptions with no evidence of recurrence in the source text. The specific True/False assignments appear largely unsupported.

per_column.name: is_assigned
per_column.rationale: Derivable directly from the existing assigned_to column, so largely redundant; useful but adds little new leverage. Values are well grounded.

per_column.name: resolved_by_assignee
per_column.rationale: Comparing assigned_to vs closed_by is a genuinely useful signal for handoff overhead affecting resolution time. Derivable from original columns; NULLs for silent rows are acceptable.

per_column.name: is_open_incident
per_column.rationale: Restates the existing 'state'/'closed_at' fields; useful for filtering but largely redundant. Values grounded in state/closed_at.

per_column.name: assigned_agent
per_column.rationale: Essentially a copy/normalization of the existing assigned_to column, so redundant. Could support per-agent resolution comparison but adds little over the original.

per_column.name: caller_id_group
per_column.rationale: Appears to be a restatement/relabel of the existing caller_id column; provides little new analytical axis for reducing resolution time. Values grounded.

judge.rationale: The strongest additions (incident_category, failure_mode, affected_system_tier) give genuine new grouping axes to diagnose where resolution time is spent, and resolved_by_assignee adds a handoff signal. Several columns (is_assigned, is_open_incident, assigned_agent, caller_id_group) largely restate existing original columns and add limited leverage. Groundedness is generally solid except recurrence_signal, which asserts recurrence for most rows without support in the source text.
